title: PersonaCard
description: Declarative SME-persona card (EPIC-00, issue #4; issue #11): the packaged, tenant-scoped definition of a subject-matter-expert persona (name, expertise, owned lanes, default model tier, guardrails) that maps onto an AgentProfile (issue #9). A persona belongs to a tenant or to the platform default ('tenant: platform'); tenants extend the library by adding their own card files under registry/personas/cards/ (one file per persona — the loader discovers all cards by scanning the directory, so adding a file adds a persona with no code change). The vocabulary enums below are a snapshot of the CLOSED platform vocabulary owned by registry/profiles/catalog.yaml (issue #9); registry/personas/registry.py additionally enforces fail-closed membership against the LIVE catalog so the two can never silently drift. Lifecycle state (draft/published/retired) is NOT a card field: publish/retire are recorded in the append-only versions/manifest.yaml ledger (registry.py), keeping published card content immutable via sha256.

id.description: Stable persona id (lowercase, dash-separated, e.g. security-sme, orchestrator). Must equal the card filename stem (<id>.yaml). A persona maps to an AgentProfile whose id is this value.

version.description: SemVer version of THIS persona card (X.Y.Z). A published (tenant, persona, version) is immutable: the registry records the card's sha256 in versions/manifest.yaml and refuses to resolve a published card whose content no longer matches. Improving a published persona means authoring a new card version and publishing it.

tenant.description: The tenant that owns this persona. 'platform' is reserved for platform-default personas shared with every tenant. Any other value is a tenant id: that tenant may extend the library with its own cards (and may shadow a platform-default persona of the same id). A persona is resolved tenant-first with a documented platform fallback — never across other tenants.

name.description: Display name of the persona (e.g. 'Security SME').

summary.description: One-line summary of what this persona is for and when to dispatch it.

expertise.description: Areas of expertise this persona brings (stack, disciplines, standards). Used by review assignment for domain scoring.

ownedLanes.description: The lanes / issue families this persona owns (e.g. security, guardrails). SME-card convention (shared-frontend SME-PROFILES). Free-form lane ids are open across tenants.

posture.description: Operational class, enforcing separation of duties: 'executor' performs primary work (write/run/ship); 'reviewer' independently reviews an executor's PR/verdict; 'auditor' adversarially audits claims/evidence. An auditor persona is never the executing persona of the task it audits (registry/personas/mapping.py guard_dispatch rejects it).

defaultModelTier.description: Default dispatch tier on the flash/pro ladder (LOW/MED -> flash, HIGH/MAX -> pro). Closed platform vocabulary (issue #9 catalog tiers). Security/architecture personas carry HIGH/MAX floors; reviewers with verification duty default LOW/MED.

guardrailPolicyRef.description: Single guardrail policy bound to this persona (atomic id or bundle id from the issue #9 guardrail-policy catalog). Executor workers bind worker-bundle; reviewer/auditor personas bind reviewer-bundle.

systemPromptRef.description: Pinned reference to the persona's primary system-prompt module in the prompt library (issue #13), shape <module>/<name>@v<n> (e.g. security-sme/primary@v1). Matches the AgentProfile systemPromptRef convention (issue #9 seeds use <role>/primary@v1). Module publication is owned by the prompt-library lane; the mapping pins the reference shape.

toolAllowlist.description: Closed allowlist of platform tool ids this persona may invoke (issue #9 catalog). Unknown tool => rejected (fail closed). Reviewer/auditor personas use a verify-only tool set.

capabilitySet.description: Closed capability set this persona may exercise (issue #9 catalog). Unknown capability => rejected (fail closed).

constraintSet.description: Boundary constraints (deny/require rules) this persona operates under (issue #9 catalog). Unknown constraint => rejected (fail closed).

memoryScope.description: Memory scopes this persona may read/write (issue #9 catalog memory scopes). At least one scope required.

provenance.description: Record of the read-only source(s) this persona card was derived from, as '<repo> <path>' strings (GR-10 provenance doctrine, docs/CANNIBALIZATION.md).

description.description: Longer narrative of the persona's role, discriminating focus and doctrine (optional).

guardrails.description: Human-readable non-negotiables this persona operates under (the SME card 'Guardrails' section; optional — machine enforcement rides on guardrailPolicyRef + constraintSet).
